assertions.source: S_N0 = (2q+1-q²)(q²-1)/(2q²): diagnostic — S(q=1) should equal 0 (Q_β · (q-1) zero meets E_0 1/(q-1) pole). Pass ⇒ confirms this S is the SDP-constraint scalar, NOT the ladder normalization. The categorical f-construction needs symbolic Q_A(q) and α(q), not Q_β/E_0.
